seo_title: AI Sizing & Style Bot: Reduce E-commerce Returns
seo_desc: Are returns sinking your online clothing store? We integrate an AI Bot that recommends the exact size and acts as a 24/7 Personal Shopper.
author_pitch: I have seen dozens of online stores go bankrupt, not from a lack of sales, but because the cost of returns due to sizing errors devoured all their margin. I develop AI Agents that advise your customers like an expert tailor, ensuring the perfect purchase on the first try.
title: AI Sizing Recommendation Bot: Eliminate Returns in Your Online Store
body:
Are logistics costs from garment returns devouring your e-commerce profit margin?

For a small fashion brand or online boutique, every return is a critical blow. Customers hesitate between two sizes, buy both, try the clothes on at home, and return the one that does not fit. This consumer habit forces you to pay double shipping, immobilizes your inventory for weeks, and destroys the profitability of your advertising campaigns.

The trap of Standard Sizing Charts

Forcing a customer to find a measuring tape to decipher a confusing centimeter chart only generates frustration and cart abandonment. Relying on static size guides is the mistake that destroys the most sales in the textile sector.

Our solution: AI Personal Shopper and Sizing Bot

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we integrate a conversational Artificial Intelligence Agent directly into your product pages. This smart assistant chats with the customer in real-time, analyzing their morphology and previous shopping habits to recommend the mathematically perfect size from your catalog.

  1. Conversational Morphological Profiling: The AI asks a couple of quick questions about height, weight, and fit preferences (tight or loose) without boring forms.
  2. Anchoring with Known Brands: The bot uses massive market data. If the customer wears an 'M' in Zara or Nike, the AI automatically calculates their exact equivalent in your brand.
  3. Intelligent Cross-Selling: While advising on sizing, the agent acts as a Personal Shopper and recommends matching accessories or complementary garments that fit the user's style.
  4. Native E-commerce Integration: It connects seamlessly with Shopify or WooCommerce, injecting the correct size directly into the shopping cart with a single click.

The Real Impact on Your Online Boutique

  • Drastic drop in returns: Reduce dreaded logistics returns by up to 50%, protecting your cash flow and freeing up stock immediately.
  • Average order value increase: Multiply the value of each order thanks to the hyper-personalized style recommendations the AI makes during the chat.
  • Premium customer experience: Transform a simple online store into a luxury boutique with 24/7 personalized attention without hiring a support team.
